plan.direction: Extend the preregistered daily Cutler RSI(2) pullback plus close-above-SMA filter to a full 360-day, twelve-fold OOS interval.
plan.reason_for_extension: The earlier 183-day screen had positive cumulative returns in some variants but zero candidates passed its six-fold consistency gate. Before selecting any parameter from those outcomes, evaluate the same frozen 3x3 RSI threshold/SMA grid over a predeclared full-year interval that includes the earlier period and the prior six months. Changed OOS boundaries/fold count make each definition distinct; no threshold, SMA length, or signal rule is selected from the earlier result.

time_boundaries.reuse_disclosure: The full period is repeated development/validation history and is not an untouched final holdout.

costs.impact: 0.5 * sample stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete UTC daily quote-volume ADV)
costs.l2_data: Unavailable; half-spread and impact are estimates.
costs.market: Unlevered long-only spot; no funding or borrow.

plan.bias_note: The full year and entire 3x3 grid reuse repeatedly studied data; the prior six-month Cutler RSI screen had 18 rejected variants. Registry had 4,349 distinct fingerprints before this 20-definition batch. Substantial multiple-testing and reuse bias remain; any positive result still requires forward paper validation.
